gzungs kyi sgo rnams bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 0)bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /snying rje chen po bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad bsam gyis myi khyab bo / /thams cad shes pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /lam gyi ②rnam pa shes pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed ①pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po pya bsnyen bkur (thub dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung rdo rib yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bzhi ⑦pa/rab 'byord kyis gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa ni zab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ rab 'byord gzugs zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa zab bo/ /rab 'byord tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa zab bo//rab 'byord 'du shes zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa zab bo / /rab 'byord 'du byed zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa zab bo/ /rab 'byord rnam par shes pa zab pa'i ⑤phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa zab bo/ /rab 'byord myig zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rna ba zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sna zab pa'i phyir/ shes 22—102

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lce zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lus zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor yid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor gzugs zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sgra zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor dri zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor ro zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo//rab 'byor reg zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo /rab 'byor chos zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab ①kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor myig gi rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sna'i rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lce'i rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lus kyi rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor yid kyi rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 22—103

'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rna (1)ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo//rab 'byor sa'i khams zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor chu'i khams zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor mye'i khams zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rlung gi khams zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo//rab 'byor nam mkha'i khams zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa'i khams zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor ma rig pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor 'du byed zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor mying dang gzugs zab pa'i 22—104

phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor skye mched drug zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor reg pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor tshor ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sred pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor len pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor srid pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor skye ba zab pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rga shi zab pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor phyi stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor phyi nang stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo//22—105

rab 'byor chen po stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor 'dus byas stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/thos rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo//rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rang bzhin stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo / /rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa ①stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor yang dag par spong ba zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 22—106

zab bo/ /rab 'byor dbang po zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor stobs zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi yan lag zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo rab 'byor bsam gtan zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor tshad myed pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 0zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa brgyad zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor mngon par shes pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor myi 'jigs pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 22—107

phyin pa zab bo/ /1tshorab 'byor snying rje chen po zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zab pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin nadapa sku ni rin po che'i phung po ste/ chos rin po che'i phung po rnams sgrub pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam sgrub pa'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /tshad myed pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa lnga sgrub pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /dbang po lnga sgrub pa'o/ /stobs lnga sgrub pa'o / /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun sgrub pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgrub pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad sgrub 4)pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu sgrub pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa sgrub pa'o/ /(5)ting nge 'dzin rnams sgrub pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu sgrub pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi sgrub pa'o/ /⑥snying rje chen po sgrub pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad sgrub pa'o//22—108

rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa'o/ /lan cig phyir (1)'ong ba'i 'bras bu sgrub pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sgrub pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid sgrub pa'ol/ /rang byang chub sgrub pa'o/ /(snyelam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sgrub pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgrub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo skor (geba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs dag pa dang / tshor ba dag pa dang / 'du shes dag pa dang / 'du byed dag pa dang / rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / myig dag pa dang / rna ba dag pa dang / sna dag pa dang / lce dag pa dang / lus dag pa dang / yid dag pa dang / gzugs dag pa dang / sgra dag pa dang / dri dag pa dang / ro dag pa dang / reg dag pa dang / chos dag pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa dag pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dag pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dag pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dag pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dag pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dag pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dag pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dag pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dag pa dang /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dag pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dag pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dag pa dang / sa'i khams dag pa dang / chu'i khams dag pa dang /22—109

mye'i khams dag pa dang / rlung gi khams dag pa dang / nam mkha'i khams dag pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams dag pa dang / ma rig pa dag pa dang / 'du byed dag pa dang / rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / mying dang gzugs dag pa dang / skye mched drug dag pa dang / reg pa dag pa dang /tshor ba dag pa dang / sred pa dag pa dang / len pa dag pa dang / srid pa dag pa dang / skye ba dag pa dang / rga shi dag pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dag pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dag pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dag pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dag pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dag pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dag pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dag pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid dag pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dag pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dag pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid dag pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dag pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dag pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dag pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dag pa dang /thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid dag pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dag pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dag pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dag pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dag pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dag pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dag pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dag pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dag pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dag pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dag pa dang / dbang po 22—110

dag pa dang / stobs dag pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dag pa dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dag pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa dag pa dang / bsam gtan dag pa dang / tshad myed pa dag pa dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag pa dang / rnam par thar pa dag pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dag pa dang / mngon par shes pa dag pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dag pa dang /gzungs kyi sgo dag pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dag pa dang /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dag pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dag pa dang /①snying rje chen po dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad dag pa dang / thams cad shes pa nyid dag pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dag pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dag pa'i phung po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo de lta bu bstan pa'i tshe/ bar chad mang du myi 'byung ba ②ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la bar chad mang po 'byung ste/ de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos ②shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri dub dang / klag ⑤pa dang / bstan dupa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba dang / bsgom par bya ba la bar chad du myi 'gyur bar bri ⑦na yang myur du bri ⑧bar bya'o/ /klag ⑨na yang myur du klag ⑩go / /bstan yin yang myur du bstan to8/ /tshul bzhin du yid la bya na yang 22—111

myur du tshul bzhin du yid la bya'o/ /bsgom na yang myur du bsgom mo/ /rab 'byor de bas na gal te ①rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di zla ba gcig gis bri bar byas ②na yang des de bzhin du bri (9bar bya'o/ /gal te zla ba gnyis sam/ gal te zla ba gsum mam④/gal te zla ba bzhi'am/ gal te zla ba lnga'am/ gal te zla ba drug gam/ gal te lo'i bar gyis bri bar byas ⑤na yang de bzhin du bri ⑥bar bya'o/ /gal te zla ba gcig gis bstan (7pa dang / lung 'bog ⑧pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba dang / bsgom par byas ⑨na yang de bzhin du bsgom par bya'o / /gal te lo'i bar gyis bsgom par byas ⑩na yang de bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni nor bu rin po che chen po ⑪la bar chad mang du 'byung ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ci tsonas kyang myi bri 8ba dang / myi klag ④pa dang /myi bstan 8pa dang / kha ton myi bgyi ba dang / yid la myi bgyi ba ⑩dang / myi bsgom pa'i slad du bdud sdig to can dag bar chad myi bgyid pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la ci nas kyang myi bri ⑩ba dang / myi klag 8pa dang / myi bstan ⑪pa dang / kha ton myi bya ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la myi bya ba dang / myi bsgom pa'i phyir du )bdud sdig to can bar chad myi byed pa yang ma yin med kyi/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri tsob dang / klog pa dang / kha ton ⑤byed pa dang / bsgom pa rnams la bar chad bya bar myi nus so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/22—112

bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i mthus na①/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri ②ba dang / klag ②pa dang / kha ton du bgyi ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyi ba dang / bsgom pa la bdud sdig to can bgegs bgyid par myi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa dag la ④bdud sdig to can gyis bar chad bya bar myi nus so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig dubazhugs shing / 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag gi bumathus kyang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ⑦ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa de dag la bdud sdig to can gyis bar chad bya bar myi nus so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la dgongs shing yongs su 'dzin pa mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis yongs su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ⑧ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang /kha ton du byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa de dag la bdud sdig to can gyis bar chad bya bar myi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/22—113

sha ra dwa ti'i bu sangs rgyas kyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ①dge ba'i chos yongs su btsal ba la/ bdud sdig to can gyis bar chad bya bar myi nus so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni gang da ②ltar phyogs bcu kun kyi 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed pa dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad myed grangs myed pa bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ③ba la dgongs pa mdzad pa dang / klog cing ston pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa la dgongs pa mdzad pa ni chos nyid kyis de bzhin te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri duzhing klog pa dang / ston cing ⑤tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa desatsong bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi mthus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri'odu/ /klog go/ /ston to/ /kha ton du byed do/ /tshul bzhin du yid la byed do/ /sgom mo zhes bya bar khong du chud par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang su yang rung ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'bri ⑦ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang / kha ton du bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa dang / sgom mo 'tshal kun kyang sangs rgyas kyi mthu lags sam/ kun kyang sangs rgyas kyis bzung ba ⑧lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te⑨/ ji skad du smras pa bzhin te/0 rigs kyi bu dang ⑫/ rigs kyi bu mo gang su 22—114

yang rung ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ①zhing klog pa dang /ston cing kha ton du byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing sgom pa de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin par rig par bya'o/ /de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyis bzung ba ②yin par rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ③zhing klog pa dang / ston cing kha ton du bgyid pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid cing sgom pa de dag 0ni shar phyogs nas phyogs bcu kun kyi 'jig rten gyi khams tshad dang grangs ma mchis pa na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad dang grangs ma mchis pa/ bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang /chos ston pa de dag gis mkhyen te/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri zhing / klog pa dang / ston cing kha ton du bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid cing sgom pa de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /thugs su chud do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / ston cing kha ton 0du byed 0pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing sgom pa de dag ni⑦/ shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang /nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad myed dugrangs myed pa de dag gis mkhyen to/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs 22—115

shing thugs su chud do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de la byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan du byed pa de dag gis kyang / 'di ltar bdag cag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar gyur to/ /zhes bya bar rig par bya'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ①pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bris shing ②glegs bam du byas te/ 'chang ba de dag kyang gshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la mos pa mang bar ④'gyur te/ de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang pos rim gror byed bkur ster byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed ⑤do//de ltar rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bris shing 0'chang ba de dag kyang don che ba dang / legs pa che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / rnam par sbyin pa che bar 'gyur te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni phyir myi ldog pa'i sa yongs su non gyi (pebar du dge ba'i rtsa ba des nam yang ngan song du skye bar myi 'gyur ro/ /nam yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang bral ⑧bar myi 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du dge 22—116

ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang nam yang bral ①bar myi 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro//bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ②nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang dunam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid dang ④nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /⑤rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral dubar myi 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /22—117

dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /stobs rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro//so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /①snying rje chen po dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /②sha ra dwa ti'i bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa 'das nas/ lho phyogs kyi 22—118

rgyud na spyod par 'gyur te/ de na byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag mos pa dam pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri bar 'gyur/ 'dzin par 'gyur/ 'chang bar 'gyur/ klog par 'gyur/ kun chub par byed par 'gyur/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed par 'gyur te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang ①pos rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed/phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba des nam yang ngan song ②log par ltung bar myi 'dong ste/ de dag gis lha dang myi'i phun sum tshogs pa myong zhing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /de dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis mngon par 'phags par gyur nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rim gro dang /bkur ste dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa ②byed cing / nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di lho phyogs kyi durgyud nas yul bar ta ni na spyod par 'gyur dute/ de na 0byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag mos pa dam pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri bar 'gyur/ 'dzin par 'gyur/ 'chang bar 'gyur/ klog par 'gyur / kun chub par byed par 'gyur/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed par 22—119

'gyur te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang pos rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed par 'gyur te/ de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba des nam yang ngan song log par ltung bar myi 'dong ste/ de dag gis lha dang myi'i phun sum ①tshogs pa myong zhing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /de dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis mngon par 'phags par gyur nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rim gro dang / bkur ste ②dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa gebyed cing / nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ④thog pa'am/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yul bar ta ni nas byang phyogs kyi rgyud na spyod par 'gyur te/ de na ⑤yang byang chub sems dpa'i 0theg pa pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag mos pa dam pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri bar 'gyur/'dzin par 'gyur/ 'chang bar 'gyur/ klog par 'gyur/ kun chub par byed par 'gyur/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed par 'gyur te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang pos rim gror byed/bkur stir gebyed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed par 'gyur te/ de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba des nam yang ngan song log par lhung bar myi 'dong ste/ de 22—120

dag gis ②lha dang myi'i phun sum tshogs pa myong zhing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /de dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis mngon par 'phags par gyur nasal/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ②la rim gro dang / bkur ste dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed cing /nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di lho phyogs kyi rgyud dang / byang phyogs kyi rgyud na phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe/ lnga brgya tha ma la sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu chos dang 'dul ba dar la bab pa'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos nub par myi 'gyur te / chos de yang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du ④nan tan du byed pa de dag la ni ngas dgongs so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri zhing ⑤bris nas kyang / me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug ⑥pa dang /phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan 22—121

mang pos rim gror ①byed/ bkur ster ②byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed pa de dag kyang ngas dgongs te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba des nam yang ngan song log par ltung bar myi 'dong ste/ de dag lha dang myi'i phun sum tshogs pa myong zhing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /de dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis mngon par 'phags par gyur nasal/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rim gro dang / bkur ste rjodang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed cing / nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni dude bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas brjod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang dusangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni lho phyogs kyi de bzhin 22—122

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang ①/ chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de 22—123

dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so//rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis 22—124

brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni 'og gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni steng gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs so/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis brjod do/ /bstod do/ /bsngags so/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di slad ma'i dus slad ma'i tshe na/ byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur te/ de la sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan par 'gyur te/ thos nas kyang mos par 'gyur ro/ /mos par byas nas kyang 'dri ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa 22—125

dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / de bzhin nyid du nan tan du ①byed par 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan cing thos nas mos par byed pa dang / mos par byas nas 'dri zhing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang zhing klog pa dang / kun chub par byed cing tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan du ②byed pa de dag ni yun ring po nas theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po ②bsnyen bkur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i dus slad ma'i tshe na④/ byang gi phyogs ⑤cha der byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan cing / thos nas mos par bgyid pa dang / mos par bgyis nas 'dri zhing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang zhing klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid cing / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa dang / de bzhin nyid ༅du nan tan du bgyid pa de lta bu ji snyed cig 'byung bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na⑦/ byang gi phyogs cha der byang chub sems dpa'i theg ⑧pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo ni mang du 'byung ⑨ste/sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ myi 'jum yongs su myi 'jum/ myi 'jigs myi sngang ⑩/ skrag par myi 'gyur ba de lta bu ni myi ⑩mang ngo //de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis de bzhin 22—126

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po'i rjes su 'brangs pa dang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po la yongs su zhus/ yongs su dris pa'i phyir te/ de'ang ①ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su 22—127

rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro / /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ dngos po skyed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ yang dag par spong ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ dbang po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni 22—128

stobs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni / byang chub kyi yan lag yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ bsam gtan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo —1de dag ni/ tshad myed pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /5rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyo mas par 'jug pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ri /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ mngon par shes pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ gzungs kyi sgo yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su 22—129

rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni①/ snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang ②rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sha ra chadwa ti'i bu rigs kyi ④bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa bas nye bar brtan 6)par 'gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du skye bo mang po'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la ni ngas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod do/ /'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 6)ji snyed cig byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang (she)/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod de / de dag tshe 'das nas kyang 'di lta ste/bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du spyod pa nyid du 'gyur te⑨ / de dag gzhan la yang 'di lta ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du rnam pa de lta bu nyid brjod par 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni mnyam par bzhag ⑩par 'gyur tsote / de dag ni bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis kyang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las bzlog par myi nus na/ sdig to la mos pa dang / sdig to'i spyod pa can shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spong ba gzhan gyis nyu2lta ci smos/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 22—130

pa zab mo 'di thos nas/ dga' zhing dang ba dang ②nyams bde ba rgya chen po ②skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du skye bo mang po yang dge ba'i chos la 'god par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am ①rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis ni nga'i mdun du 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das bdag cag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / srog chags stong phrag mang po dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po byang chub tu rab tu dgod ④par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par bstan par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par bskul bar bgyi'o/ /yang dag par gzeng ⑤bstod par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par dga' bar bgyi'o/ /phyir myi ldog par lung bstan par bgyi'o zhes bya ba'i tshig smras so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi tshig ni sems la ⑥sems kyis rnam par bltas te⑦/ ngas rjes su dgyes par stimadzad do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar yang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis 'di skad du bdag cag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / srog chags stong phrag mang po dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po byang chub tu dgod ⑨par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par bstan par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par bskul bar bgyi'o/ /yang dag par gzeng ⑩bstod par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par 0dga' bar bgyi'o/ /phyir myi ldog par lung bstan par bgyi'o/ /zhes bya ba'i tshig smras so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs 22—131

pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi tshig ni sems la thugs kyis 1rnam par gzigs te rjes su dgyes par (du snamadzad do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / srog chags stong phrag mang po dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rab tu 'god par 'gyur ros/ /yang dag par ston par 'gyur/ yang dag par skul bar 'gyur/ yang dag par gzeng stod chopar 'gyur/ yang dag par dga' bar byed par 'gyur/ phyir myi ldog par lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg la mos pa rlabs po cher 'gyur te/ de dag sbyin pa rlabs po che gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa rlabs po che btang 5zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che mngon par 'du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che dzimangon par 'du mubyas nas / rnam par spyin pa rlabs po che yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba de dgazu /rnam par sbyin pa rlabs chen po 9yongs su bzung nas/ sems can de dag nyid kyi don du rnam par sbyin pa rlabs po che dzilas de bas kyang ches rlabs che ba'i rnam par spyin pa yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar phyi'am nang gi dngos po de dag kyang / sems can de dag nyid la yongs su gtong bar 'gyur te / de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan gang na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'de 22——132

nyid kyi chos ston pa mngon du gyur pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag la rten 0)par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis (bde bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di mngon sum du thos nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu yang srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / srog chags stong phrag mang po dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par ston par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par skul bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par gzeng stod ②par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos rnams las/ chos gang thugs su ma chud pa de lta bu gang yang ma mchis so0/ /de bzhin nyid dang chos nyid gang thugs su ma chud pa de lta bu gang yang ma mchis so / /sems can rnams kyi sems thugs su ma chud pa de lta bu gang yang ma mchis pa ⑤ni ngo mtshar che ste/ 'di ltar 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang nyan thos rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang nyan thos rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang (6)nyan thos rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /phyogs 22—133

bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang /chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang nyan thos rnams kyang yongs su mkhyen to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag gi slad du brtson par bgyid cing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag tshol 0)ba dang yongs su tshol ②ba'i tshe/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag tshol ①ba dang / ④yongs su tshol ⑤ba lasabu/la las ni btsal ba las pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag thob par 'gyural/la las ni thob par myi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni (kyede lta stim yin te/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo brtson 'grus myi gtong ba de dag kun gyis kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag gi don du brtson par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis mdo sde zab mo zab mo rmo )pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa 'di dag kun kyang 'grub par 'gyur ram/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis mdo sde zab mo zab mo ⑩pa rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa 'di dag myi 'grub par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gnas myed skabs myed do/ /de ci'i phyir 22—134

zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu ①de ltar bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems can rnams yang dag par ston cing / yang dag par skul ba dang /yang dag par gzeng stod ②pa dang / yang dag par dga' bar byed pa dang /'god cing rab tu gzhog pa las kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo tshe 'das nas kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni nam sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par ma byas/ sems can yongs su sbyin par ma byas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par ma gyur gyi bar du ji skad du bstan pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag las brtson 'grus nyam ③par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/le'u sum cu'o④// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po lnga ⑤pa/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa/sems can yongs su spyin par bgyid pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin ⑥pa de dag gi yon tan yongs su brjod pa ni 'di dag lags na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod pa de dag la ⑦bar chad ⑧du 'gyur ba ji lta bu dag mchis/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor spobs pa ha cang 'phyi ste skye 22—135

na / rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du spobs hu)pa ha cang 'phyi ste skye bar 'gyur/ de ni ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos (2bdud kyi las su rig par bgyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dka' bar yongs su rdzogs par byed/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dka' bar yongs su rdzogs par byed/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dka' bar yongs su rdzogs par byed/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dka' bar yongs su rdzogs par byed/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dka' bar yongs su rdzogs par byed/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dka' bar yongs su rdzogs par byed na/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des shin tu 'phyi ste spobs pa bskye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shin tu myur bar spobs pa skye ⑤na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das (6)ci'i slad du shin tu myur bar spobs pa skye bar 'gyur/ de ni ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin 22—136

pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ thabs myi mkhas pas ha cang myur bar ①spobs pa skye la des rlom sems su byed na/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na spobs pa ha cang myur bar skye ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang glal zhing (bshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ②'dri stin/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dgod ⑤cing 'dri yin/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor phan tshun steg cing 'dri na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /sems g.yeng zhing ⑦'dri na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /yi ge gzhan la chags shing tshig gi don myi shes par 'dri na/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi shelas su rig par bya'o/ /'di'i ro ma myong nas stan las langs te 'gro na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang glal zhing 0lung 'bog na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o / /glal zhing ⑩kha ton byed dam/ 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/'o/ klog gam / ston pa dang / glal zhing mtshul bzhin du yid la byed na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o//22—137

rab 'byor gzhan yang phan tshun dgod (7cing 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang phan tshun steg cing 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam / klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed na/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang sems g.yeng pas 'dzin tam/'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang yi ge gzhan dang gzhan la chags shing 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam / tshul bzhin du yid la byed na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang 'di skad du 'di'i ro ma myong nas stan las langs te 'gro na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du 'di'i ro myi myong bar 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 22—138

dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la ma spyad ①pa de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las bdag cag lung ma bstan to zhes/ ma dad pa'i yid kyis stan las langs shing 'dong ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las lung ma bstan pa (kyede dag stan las langs shing mchi bar 'gyur / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po niskyon myed par ma chud pa ni/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung myi bstan te④/ de la bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las myi 'byung ngo / /bdag gi mying yang yongs su ⑤ma brjod do zhes dad par ma gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di las ⑥byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gi ༅ming yongs su ma brjod pa lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lung ma bstan pa rnams kyi mying ni yongs su myi rjod ⑧de / de la bdag gi lamying yang 'di las myi 'byung / bdag gang du skyes pa'i grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal gyi mying 'di yang myi 'byung ngo zhes/de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi mnyan tu )to snyam byed cing / 'khor de nas ⑪'gro bar sems na/ sems bskyed pa des ji lta 8ji ltar 'gro bar sems shing 22—139

gom pa ji snyed cig bor ba de snyed kyi bskal pa yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/de dag la gzod 07brtson par bya (midagos so/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bor zhing mdo sde gang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes yongs su myi sgrub pa de dag kun chub par bya bar sems te/ des na byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shing gi rtsa ba spangs te de nyid kyi yal ga chadang / 'dab byam dang / lo ma la 'ju bar sems par gyur pa dag ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes yongs su myi sgrub ⑤pa'i mdo sde kun chub par bgyi bar sems par 'gyur ba de dag yigang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde gang nyan thos dang ldan pa'am/ra nga sangs rgyas dang ldan pa de medag ste/ 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnams te/ de dag la gnas shing rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob na pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob pa ⑨dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob pa tshedang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob (spepa dang / rang byang chub thob / par 'gyur gyi/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nyunyepar myi 'gyur ba ste/ rab 'byor de dag ni nyan thos dang / rang 22—140

sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde gang la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bor zhing kun chub par bya bar sems pa ①ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes yongs su myi sgrub ②pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos (mishes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos ④kyis 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams la slob ⑤pa yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na / khyi la la zhig jo yibo'i zan nar ma bor te las myi las zan btsal bar sems pa dang 'dra bar gde bzhin du/ rab 'byor ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa 'di bor te/ yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab postem lta bu'i mdo sde nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa dag la brtan ⑨par sems pa 'byung ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am lho )rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bor nas khe dang bkur snyi'i nyunyephyir nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde rnams kun chub par bya bar sems pa 'byung 7ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ myi la la 22—141

zhig glang po che ①'dod la des glang po che rnyed nas glang po che'i ②rjes btsal bar sems pa tshiyod na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ④de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i gang zag gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bor zhing mdo sde gang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa de dag btsal ⑤bar sems pa de sbyonadag kyang dpe de dang 'dra bar rig par bya ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ myi zhig rgya mtsho chen po blta bar 'dod la/ ba lang (7gi rjes btsal bar sems shing / des bal glang nigi rjes mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du rgya mtsho chen po'i tshad 'di dang mnyam mam stigi mnyam snyam na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de 4) mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo tunyethos shing rnyed kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ⑩bor zhing spangs te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag gzung tunyeb dang kun chub par bya bar sems pa hunyede dag kyang rnam pa de ltar rig par bya ste/ rab 'byor de yang nyusnyebyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ phywa ⑩mkhan nam phywa ⑩mkhan 22—142

gyi slob mas ①rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa'i tshad du khang pa zhig ②dbub cing bslang bar du'adod de nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzhal myed khang yongs su btsal bar sems shing / nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzhal myed khang las tshad blang bar sems na/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu des nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzhal myed khang gi tshad kyis 0rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa'i ④tshad dang dpe tshul bzung ste/ de dang 'dra ba'i dukhang pa dbub par nus sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ phywa dumakhan nam/ phywa ⑨mkhan gyi slob ma de mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu de ni byis pa'i ngang tshul can du rig par bgyi ste/ mkhas pa'i ngang hu)tshul can ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo la la (nyeshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos shing rnyed nas kyang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo bor zhing spangs te/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag las rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su btsal bar sems pa 'byung 8na/ rab 'byor de la 0ji snyam du sems/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi laso su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu la la zhig 22—143

'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mthong bar 'dod la/ des khams kyi rgyal phran mthong nas/ 'di snyam du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de kha dog dang /dbyibs kyis ji 0)'dra ba zhig yod ces des khams kyi rgyal phran mthong ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs kyi rdo mtshan ma bzung bar bsams gte/ 'di skad du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de'i kha dog dang / dbyibs dang tshul dang mtshan ma yang ④sa'i bdag po 'di 'dra ba zhig yod grang (5)zhes zer na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang ⑥rigs kyi bu mo gang la la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos shing rnyed kyang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di (7)bor zhing spangs te/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su btsal bar sems pa 'byung 2na/ rab 'byor de la ⑨ji snyam du sems / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu shin tu bkres pa la la zhig gis ro brgya dang ldan pa'i kha zas rnyed kyang drug cu 7pa'i kha zas btsal bar sems shing /des kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa de bor nas/ drug cu nyu1pa'i kha zas la bza' 22—144

bar sems stin/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'amardo / rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos shing rnyed ①kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo byabor zhing spangs te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag las rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su btsal bar sems pa 'byung (snyen/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu la la zhig gis nor bu rin po che rin thang myed pa rnyed nas/ nor bu mching bu dang bsgrun 99)par bsams na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de (7mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam/ gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rab 'byor de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi 58)bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos shing rnyed nas kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ⑨bor zhing spangs te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su btsal bar sems pa 22—145

'byung na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni ①mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin nam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba'i tshe/ spobs pa mang po gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba'i dkrugs mar 'gyur ba de lta bu skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ltar gzugs kyi spobs pa dang / sgra'i spobs pa dang / dri'i spobs pa dang / ro'i spobs pa dang / reg gi spobs pa dang / chos kyi spobs pa dang / sbyin pa'i spobs pa dang / tshul khrims kyi spobs pa dang / bzod pa'i spobs pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi spobs pa dang / bsam gtan gyi spobs pa dang / shes rab kyi spobs pa dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi spobs pa dang / gzugs kyi khams kyi spobs pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i khams kyi spobs pa dang / lung dbog ②pa dang / kha ton bya ba'i spobs pa dang / rim gror ③bya ba'i spobs pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i spobs pa dang / yang dag par spong ba'i spobs pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i spobs pa dang / dbang po'i spobs pa dang / stobs kyi spobs pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag gi spobs pa dang / lam gyi spobs pa dang /bsam gtan gyi spobs pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i spobs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spobs pa dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i spobs pa dang / nang stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / phyi nang stong pa 22—146

nyid kyi spobs pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi spobs pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spobs pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spobs pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spobs pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spobs pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spobs pa dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spobs pa dang / stobs bcu'i spobs pa ①dang /myi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa'i spobs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i spobs pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras ②bu'i spobs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i spobs pa dang /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i spobs pa dang / dgra bcom pa'i spobs pa dang /rang byang chub kyi spobs pa dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi spobs pa skye bar ①'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni spobs pa myed pas rnam par byang ba'o/ /rab 22—147

'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gyis myi khyab pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sems myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni skye ba myed cing 'gag pa myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni kun nas nyon mongs pa skyed cing rnam par byang ba myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'khrug pa myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rnam par byang ba myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/chos de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la myed cing myi dmyigs te / rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ①'dri ba'i tshe/ chos de dag gis 'khrug par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am (2)rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi chabadud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bri bar nus sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de lta ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi 22—148

pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so / /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang 22—149

pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi ①dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /②rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so//gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes 22—150
