pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid 17yod pa ma yin te mi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad 3 mkhyen pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin te myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid myi dmyigs pa gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ dngos po myed pas dngos po med pa bri bar myi nus so/ /rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di dngos po myed ces bya bar 'du shes na/ de yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ri /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yi ger bris nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bdag cigis bris so zhes mchi na/ de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la yi ger mngon par chags pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu 5phyin pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das gzugs ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /'du shes ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /'du byed ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /myig ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rna ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sna ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lce ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lus ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /yid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /gzugs ni yi ge 22—151

ma mchis pa'o/ /sgra ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /dri ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /ro ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /reg ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /chos ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma 1mchis pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma 3 mchis pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o / /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sa'i khams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /chu'i khams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /mye'i khams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rlung gi khams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /'du byed ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /skye mched drug ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /22—152

reg pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /tshor ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sred pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /len pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /srid pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /skye ba ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rga shi ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o//phyi nang stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o//rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o//myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o /dbang po rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /stobs rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ①ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /tshad myed pa 22—153

rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /①snying rje chen po ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /thams cad shes pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'ol/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni yi ge ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das gal te byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo yi ge ma mchis pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags par bgyid la(kye/ yi ge ma mchis pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags par bgyid cing zhus/ yi ge ma mchis pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags par bgyid dupa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i nang stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa 22—154

dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i phyi stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i phyi nang stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i chen po stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i don dam pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i 'dus byas stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang /yi ge ma mchis pa'i dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i dngos po skyed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis 22—155

pa'i yang dag par spong ba rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i dbang po rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i stobs rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i bsam gtan rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i tshad myed pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i mngon par shes pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i gzungs kyi sgo rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i myi 'jigs pa rnams la mngon par chags 22—156

par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / ①yi ge ma mchis pa'i snying rje chen po la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i thams cad shes pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid pa dang /yi ge ma mchis pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par chags par bgyid nasti/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bgyi'o③/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / kha ton byed pa dang / zhu ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /0 klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa'i tshe yul gyi yid la bya ba mang po skyed na/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang phyirigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / kha ton byed pa dang / zhu ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /9 klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang sgom pa'i tshe/ grong gi yid la bya ba dang / grong chardal gyi yid la bya ba dang / khams kyi yid la bya ba dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor gyi yid la 22—157

bya ba dang / khyim gyi yid la bya ba dang / bla ma dang / mkhan po'i ①yid la bya ba dang / ma dang ldan pa'i ②yid la bya ba dang / pha dang ldan pa'i ①yid la bya ba dang / phu nu dang ldan pa'i ④yid la bya ba dang / sring mo dang ldan pa'i (nyeyid la bya ba dang / gnyen bshes dang ldan pa'i ⑥yid la bya ba dang /rkun tsopo dang ldan pa'i ⑧yid la bya ba dang / phyag dar ba dang ldan pa'i ⑨yid la bya ba dang / 'jig rten pa dang ldan pa'i tunyeyid la bya ba dang / sbrul tunye'atshong ma dang ldan pa'i 8yid la bya ba dang / bud myed dang ldan pa'i tsoyid la bya ba dang / yid la bya ba gzhan mang po skye na/ rab 'byor 8shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /lung 'bog ④pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du 0yid la byed pa'i tshe / bar chad bya ba'i phyir bdud sdig to can 'khrug par 'gyur ba nye bar sbyor tertsonye/ de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba'i tshe/ khe dang bkur sti 8dang / tshigs su bcad ⑩pa dang / chos gos dang zas dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang / yo byad mang po byung la byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i tshe/ de dag gi ro myong bar byed nal/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang /22—158

lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i tshe / bar chad de lta bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i latheg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa'i tshe bdud sdig to can dag mdo sde zab mo ②zab mo gang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'ini / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa skyed pa dag nye bar bsnyen par byed de/ de la ④byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am⑤/ rigs kyi bu mo thabs mkhas pas bdud kyis dubasnyen pa'i mdo sde zab mo zab mo ⑦de dag la 'dod pa mi skyed ⑧do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed pa ma yin no/ / rab 'byor ⑨de la byang chub sems dpa' thabs myi mkhas pa 0dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas spang bar sems te/ de la ngas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la thabs mkhas pa yang rgya cher bstan te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las kyang thabs mkhas pa rgya cher ⑩btsal bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bor zhing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang 22—159

ldan pa'i mdo sde dag las thabs mkhas pa btsal bar sems pa tsho3yod na/rab 'byor de la yang 27byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/le'u sum cu gcig go // //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po drug chopa/rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri rab dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya bar dga' trel chos smra ba ni phyi shol byed na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri shub dang / lung 'bog pa dang /kha ton bya bar phyi shol myi byed la/ chos nyan pa ni yul gzhan du 'gro na/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri 2ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya bar 'dod la/ chos smra ba ni yul gzhan du 'gro na/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni khe dang bkur sti tsudang / tshigs su bcad chopa lhur len cing 11gos dang / zas dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang /yo byad lhur len la chos nyan pa ni 'dod pa nyung zhing chog shes la rab tu dben zhing brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myi g.yeng ba sems rtse 22—160

gcig tu 'dus pa ①shes rab dang ldan pa zhig ste/ khe dang bkur stes (ge'ajigs na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen ②gi ldan pa ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes la rab tu dben zhing brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myi g.yeng ba/ sems rtse gcig tu 'dus pa/ shes rab dang ldan pa zhig ste/ khe dang bkur stes ④'jigs la chos nyan pa ni 'dod pa che zhing sdig to 'dod la/khe dang bkur sti dudang / tshigs su bcad 0pa lhur len cing / gos dang /zas dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang / yo byad lhur len na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu (7)rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni dgon pa pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ phyag dar khrod pa/ zas phyis myi len pa/ stan gcig pa/ ci thob pa'i bsod snyoms len pa/ dur khrod pa/ bla gab myed pa/ shing drung pa/ cog pu pa/gzhi ji bzhin pa/ chos gos gsum par gyur la/ chos nyan pa ni dgon pa pa stim yin / bsod snyoms pa ma yin/ phyag dar khrod pa ma yin/ zas phyis mi len pa ma yin/ stan gcig tso)pa ma yin/ ci thob pa'i bsod snyoms len pa ma yin/dur khrod pa ma yin/ bla gab med pa ma yin/ shing drung pa ma yin/ cog pu pa ma yin / gzhi ji bzhin pa ma yin/ chos gos gsum pa ma yin na/ rab 'byor de 22—161

yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni dgon pa pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ phyag dar khrod pa/ zas phyis myi len pa/ stan gcig ①pa/ zas ci thob pa'i bsod snyoms len pa/ dur khrod pa/ bla gab myed pa/ shing drung pa/ cog pu pa/gzhi ci ②bzhin pa/ chos gos gsum par gyur la/ chos smra ba ni dgon pa pa ma yin / bsod snyoms pa ma yin/ phyag dar khrod pa ma yin/ zas phyis myi len pa ma yin/ stan gcig ①pa ma yin/ ci thob pa'i bsod snyoms len pa ma yin/dur khrod pa ma yin/ bla gab myed pa ma yin/ shing drung pa ma yin/ cog pu pa ma yin/ gzhi ji bzhin pa ma yin/ chos gos gsum pa ma yinadu/ bsod snyoms len pa ma yin na/⑤ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen mi ldan pa ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni dad cing bsam pa dge la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri yibar 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton byed par 'dod la/ chos smra ba ni ma dad pa/ tshul khrims ngan pa can⑦/ sdig to'i duchos can zhig ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri ⑨bar myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton byed par )myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 7'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa 22—162

ste / rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni dad cing bsam pa dge la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bri bar hu)'dod/ lung 'bogs ②par 'dod/ kha ton bya bar ②'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni ma dad na/rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni/ bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong zhing sems la chags pa myed ladu/ chos nyan pa ni ser sna can chags pa'i sems dang ldan zhing du'ajungs par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong zhing sems la chags pa myed ⑥la/ chos smra ba ni ser sna can chags pa'i sems dang ldan zhing 'jungs par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni chos smra ba la gos dang / zas dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang / yo byad yongs su gtong bar 'dod la chos smra ba ⑦ni len par myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 22—163

zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ①chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni glengs pa tsam gyis shes la/ chos nyan pa ni dkri (midagos shing tshig lhur len par gyur na / rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog (kyepa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o//rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni glengs pa tsam gyis shes la/ chos smra ba ni dkri (gedagos shing tshig lhur len par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin (gepa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi (yedang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa ⑦bstan pa'i chos kyi khyad par shes la chos nyan pa ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad (8)pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi 0dang /'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang /chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa bstan pa'i chos kyi khyad par myi shes na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 22—164

pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi tsho)dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang /skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa (pebastan pa'i chos kyi khyad par shes la/chos smra ba ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang /tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi 55)dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa ④bstan pa'i chos kyi khyad par myi shes na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan la/ chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang myi ldan na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan la/ chos smra ba ni ⑤pa rol tu phyin pa drug dang myi ldan na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab 22—165

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la thabs mkhas la/ chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la/ thabs myi mkhas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen 0)myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la thabs mkhas la/ chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la thabs myi mkhas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gzungs thob par gyur la/ chos nyan pa ni gzungs ma thob na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gzungs thob par gyur la/ chos smra ba ni gzungs ma thob na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste / rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi 22—166

las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni bri hu)bar 'dod/klag ②par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton bya bar 'dod/ mnyan par 'dod / ① bsgom par 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni bri ④bar myi 'dod/ klag (snyepar myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton bya bar myi 'dod/ mnyan par myi 'dod/ bsgom par myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni bri bar 'dod/ klag ⑥par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod(pe/ kha ton bya bar 3)'dod / mnyan par 'dod la chos smra ba ni bri spubar myi 'dod/ klag ⑩par myi 'dod / lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton bya bar myi 'dod/ bsgom par myi 'dod par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu 0rkyen myi ldan pa ste / rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bral/ gnod sems dang snyom 8pa dang / gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang bral the tsom dang bral la/ chos nyan pa ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bcas/ gnod sems dang snyom 8pa dang / gnyid dang / 'gyod pa dang bcas ⑩the tsom dang bcas par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las 22—167

su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bral/ gnod sems dang / snyom 3)pa dang / gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang bral/the tsom dang bral la/ chos smra ba ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bcasal/ gnod sems dang / snyom pa dang / gnyid dang / 'gyod pa dang bcas/ the tsom dang bcas par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste / rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i tshe/ la la zhig der 'ongs te/ sems can dmyal ba'i myi snyan pa brjod / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas gokyi yul gyi myi snyan pa brjod (gecing / sems can dmyal ba ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo/ /byol song gi skye gnas ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo/ /gyoyi das/sa kyi yul ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo/ /khyod kyis sdug bsngal 'di nyid du mthar phyin par gyis shig /gang la sdug bsngal stong phrag mang po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'iphya/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis khyod la 3)ci zhig rgyal/ khyod yun ring por 'khor ba na 'khor bar gyur ta re zhes zer na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan 22—168

yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i tshe/ la la zhig der 'ongs te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod ①cing / sum cu (gertsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ mtshe ma'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ snang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung snang gi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshad myed 9gyisnang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/dge ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung dge'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjo da/ che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung che'i rdogelha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ myi che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ myi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'og myin gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye 22—169

mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod cing / 'dod pa'i khams ni 'dod pa la longs spyod pas 'di ltar bde'o/ /gzugs kyi khams ni bsam gtan dang snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis 'di ltar bde'o/ //snagazugs myed pa'i khams ni snyoms par 'jug pa zhi ba rnams kyis 'di ltar bde ste37/ de dag kyang myi rtag cing sdug bsngal la bdag myed do / /rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can zad pa'i chos can/ 'jig ripa'i chos can/ skye ba'i chos can/phye 'gag pa'i chos can yin gyis6/ khyod kyis 'di nyid du rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyis shig /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyis shigatsu /'di nyid du rang byang chub thob par gyis shig /phyin chad 'khor ba na ma 'khor bar gyis shig ces zer na/rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la chos nyan pa ni 'khor gyi nang na gnas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni na gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la/ chos smra ba ni 'khor gyi nang na gnas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi 22—170

ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gcig pu ste / zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa 6)yin la/ chos nyan pa ni tshogs yongs su sdud na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' ②sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la/ chos smra ba ni tshogs yongs su sdud na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni 'di skad du/ su nga'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'drir ③sbyin no zhes zer la/ chos nyan pa ni phyi bzhin myi 'brang na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste / rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni chos smra ba'i ④phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'dod la chos smra ba ni drung du 'gro ba'i skabs myi 'byed na/rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /22—171

rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'drir stigazhug par 'dod/ klog tu gzhug par 'dod / lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton byed du gzhug ②par 'dod la/chos nyan pa ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir drung du 'gro bar ma mos (min/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bri ④bar 'dod/ klog par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/kha ton bya bar 'dod/ sgom par 'dod/ nyan par 'dod la chos smra ba ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sbyin par myi 'dod/'drir (gegazhug par myi 'dod/ klog tu gzhug par myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton byed du gzhug par myi 'dod/ sgom du gzhug par myi 'dod / nyan du gzhug par myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi ༷6)las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gang du srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang /kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems 22—172

dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gang du srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos smra ba ni der 'gro bar ①kyi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen mi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gang na zas dkon pa dang / ②chu dkon pa'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o//rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gang na zas dkon pa dang / chu dkon pa'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos smra ba ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/byurab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o//rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gang na zas mod pa dang / chu mod pa'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa yang rjes su 'brang na/ des de la 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod zang zing gi don tu song ste ji 0rung / legs par bsam pa sems par ④gyis shig /zas thob ma thob dang bsod myi bsod ⑤kyis 'gyod par gyur ta re zhes zer na/ de'i ②phyir chos ston pa des kyang /22—173

thabs phra mos chos la spang ba byas par 'gyur te/ de yang myi dga' zhing 'di snyam du 'du shes te①/ 'di ni sbyin par 'dod pa'i mtshan ma ma yin gyi②/spong ba'i mtshan ma yin no snyam na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dge slong chos smra ba ni gang na rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom po'i 'jigs pa dang /rngon pa'i ①'jigs pa dang / gcan zan ༷khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / sbrul gyi 'jigs pa dang / 'brog dgon pa'i 'jigs pa yod pa der 'gro bar 'dod la/chos nyan pa dag kyang chos kyi don tu chos kyis skom zhing rjes su 'brang na/ dge slong chos smra bas ⑤chos nyan pa de dag la 'di skad dusmras te/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed stigang na rkun 0po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom po'i 'jigs pa dang / rngon pa'i 'jigs pa dang / gcan zan 0khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / sbrul gyi 'jigs pa dang / 'brog dgon pa'i 'jigs pa yod pa der song ⑩ste/ ci ⑩rung zhes de ltar dge slong chos smra ba des chos myi bstan pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'drir gzhug par myi 'dod/ klog tu gzhug par myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton byed du gzhug 8par myi 'dod/nyan du gzhug par myi 'dod par gyur la(nye/ de dag gis dge slong chos smra ba'i tshig de dag thos nas/ myi dga' zhing myi dga' ba'i tshul can du gyur te/dge slong chos smra ba gang na ba der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang /22—174

kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dge slong chos smra ba ni bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong khyer gtso bor byed par 'gyur ①te/ de bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong khyer gtso bor gyur pas bsod ②snyoms gtong ba'i grong ②de dag yang dang yang blta ④bar sems shing /der yang dang yang blta bas chos nyan pa phyir zlog ⑤cing / tshe dang ldan pa dag ngas ni bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong blta dgos te/ bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong du 'gro dgos so zhes dunas/ des gachos nyan pa de dag phyir bzlog pa'i ⑧phyir 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen mi ldan pa ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / ci spunas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di su yang 'dri bar myi 'gyur ba dang / lung 'bog par myi 'gyur ba dang / kha ton byed par myi 'gyur ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed par myi 'gyur ba de lta de ltar thabs sbyor ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du bgyis shing /ci phonyenas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di su yang 'dri bar myi 'gyur ba dang / lung 'bog par myi 'gyur ba dang / kha ton bgyid ⑩par myi 'gyur ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid 8par myi 'gyur ba de lta de ltar 22—175

thabs sbyor ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de hu)la bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / 'di skad du nged kyis ji ltar khong du chud pa 'di (gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yin te/ji skad du khyed klog pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no zhes dbyin ②byed cing zlog ④kyil mos pa myed par byed do/ /rab 'byor de la bdud sdig to can gyis de ltar dbyin byas pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' gang lung ma bstan pa de dag ni the tsom (deraskye bar 'gyur te/ de dag the tsom du gyur nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi (6)'dri bar ༅'gyur/ myi klog par 'gyur / lung myi 'bog par 'gyur/ kha ton myi byed par 'gyur/ myi sgom par 'gyur/ tshul bzhin du yid la (8)byed par myi ⑨'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 0'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du byas nas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs shing 'di skad du/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyustegang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa de ni yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byed par 'gyur te/rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob hu par 'gyur ro/ /de ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob 12par 'gyur ro/ /de ni rang byang chub thob ④par 'gyur ro zhes zer na/ des tshig de thos nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yonyel myi spyod na/22—176

rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ston pa'i tshe/bar chad du 'gyur ba'i bdud kyi las mang du 'byung ①ste/ bdud kyi las de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos (2rig par bya'o/ /rig par byas nas ①rnam par spang bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdud kyi las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rig par bgyi ste④/ spang bar bgyi ba ⑤de dag gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor 9bebasam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las te/ de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rig par bya ste/(7 rnam par spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rig par bya ste rnam par spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nang 22—177

stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ①rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma myed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa myed pa gang gis/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ②par 'gyur ba dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub thob ①par 'gyur ba de dag kyang bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la nye bar bsnyen ④te/ de yang de la dga' ba bskyed ⑤na / rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang /lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o//22—178

rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du lus gser gyi ①kha dog dang / myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang ②ldan par byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs te/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ①mos pa bskyed dudo/ /des mos pa bskyed ⑤nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyam ⑥par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang ④byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i mdun du sangs rgyas las stsogs pa ⑧dge slong gi dge 'dun nye bar ston te/ des de la 'dod pa skyed 0cing / bdag kyang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di lta bur shog shigatu )/ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'dis tshogs yongs su bsdus pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dis 0chos ji ltar ston pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang chos bstan par bya'o zhes de de la 'dod pa skyed 4)pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las hunyeyongs su nyams tunyepar 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag byang chub 22—179

sems dpa' brgya phrag du ma/ byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag du ma/ byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong phrag du ma/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 1spyod pa de lta bu dag nye bar ston te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa de dag la 'dod pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ /des de dag la 'dod pa bskyed 2nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyams par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang /sgom pa dang tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang 4chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o / /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la gzugs myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /'du shes myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa 5skyed do/ /myig myed do/ /rna ba myed do/ /sna myed do/ /lce myed do/ /lus myed do/ /yid myed do/ /gzugs myed do//sgra myed do/ /dri med do/ /ro myed do/ /reg myed do/ /chos myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /22—180

lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te 1reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sa'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /ma rig pa myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /skye mched drug myed do/ /reg pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /sred pa myed do/ /len pa myed do/ /srid pa myed do/ /skye ba myed do/ /rga shi myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid phyed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 22—181

myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed do/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi lhayan lag rnams myed do / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa 2 nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do / /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed do/ /rang byang chub myed do/ / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gang la gzugs myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la ④tshor ba myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do//byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /22—182

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la 'du shes skyed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do / /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la 'du byed myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rnam par shes pa myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la myig myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rna ba myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la sna myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do//nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la lce myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la lus myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /22—183

rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la yid myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do / /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la gzugs myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la sgra myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la dri myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la ro myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la reg myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la chos myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /rang sangs rgyas skyed do//nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa de la sangs rgyas 22—184

snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed pa ①de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la mngon par shes pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la ting nge 'dzin rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do / /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la myi 'jigs pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /22—195

gang la so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /tshophogang la snying rje chen po myed nga/ de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la dgra bcom pa nyid 2 myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do / /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rang byang chub myed 22—196

pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do//rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo // //①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bdun ②pa/rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bar chad du 'gyur ba mang ba ②ste/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag la yang bar chad du 'gyur ba mang ngo / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i bugling 'di'i ⑤rin po che gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bee ḍūrya ⑥dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi (7)ru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag ni bar chad du 'gyur ba mang zhing phyir rgol ba mang ba dag go/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog (8)pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag la yang bdud kyi las mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bar chad mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyir rgol ba mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin rnatshi/ /bde bar 22—197

gshegs pa de ni de bzhin te/ 'dzam bu'i ①ming 'di'i ②rin po che zhugaser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūrya dudang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi duru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram gang ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag ni bar chad du 'gyur ba mang zhing slar rgol ba mang ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid ⑥pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag la yang bdud kyi las mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bar chad mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /slar rgol ba mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na / bcom ldan 'das skyes bu glen pa gang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid ⑦pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de medag gi bar chad bgyid pa stini bdud kyi ⑩byin kyis brlabs ⑫pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu glen pa de dag ni 0blo chung zhing blo zhan par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu glen pa gang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang ⑫/ klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid ④pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag gi bar chad bgyid pa de dag ni blo rgya shin tu chung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi 0chos rlabs po che dag la de dag gi sems myi 'jug go / /de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo ⑩'di myi 'dri myi klog /lung myi 'bog /kha ton myi bgyid/ myi sgom/ tshul bzhin du yid la myi 22—198

bgyid de/ gzhan 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang /① kha ton bgyid pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa dag la yang bar chad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi 'dri myi klog /lung myi 'bog /kha ton myi byed/ myi sgom/ tshul bzhin du yid la myi byed cing /gzhan 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dag gi bar chad byed pa de dag ni bdud kyi ②byin gyis brlabs pa④/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu chung ba/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsgrubs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su ma zin pa sha stag 'byung ste/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni blo chung zhing blo zhan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo ⑤'di myi 'dri/ myi klog /lung myi 'bog /kha ton myi byed/ myi sgom / tshul bzhin du yid la myi byed cing / gzhan 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dag cigi bar chad byed pa de ⑥dag ni blo rgya ④shin tu chung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rlabs po che dag la de dag gi sems myi 'jug go/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang /klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dag la bdud kyi las 'di dag kyang 'byung med kyi 22—199

'on kyang / rab 'byor rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog cing kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / gong du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / bzod pa'i pha la rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /gong du nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid 22—200

stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gong du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dbang po rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gong du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / bsam gtan rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / ①snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang /thams cad shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes 22—201

pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed cing ①/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed na/ rab 'byor de ni sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin par shes par bya ste/ des rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri'o/ /klog go/ /lung 'bog go/ /kha ton byed do//tshul bzhin du yid la byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs 22—202

su rdzogs par byed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dbang po rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ tsho/bsam gtan rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /①snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yongs su rdzogs ②par byed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 22—203

yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ①ba dang / klag ②pa dang /lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba ③dang / bstan ④pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang rigs kyi bu'am ⑤rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ⑥'di bri ⑦ba dang /klag (rmedapa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba ⑨dang / bstan ⑩pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri yib dang / klag tu pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang /bstan 8pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri nyusteb dang / klag tunyepa dang / lung 'bog pa dang /kha ton bya ba dang / bstan nyunyepa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ⑩ba dang /22—204

klag ①pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan ②pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ②ba dang / klag ④pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba ⑤dang / bstan ⑥pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ⑦ba dang /klag 0pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan ⑨pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ / sgonub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri pho )ba dang / klag tunyepa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan tunyepa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /za8'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri 8ba dang / klag 8pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan ⑩pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang /22—205

rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ①ba dang / klag du pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang /bstan ①pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /shar phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri ④zhing / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang /ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par ⑤byed do/ /lho phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri yizhing / klog pa dang /lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston ⑦pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do//nub phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par 0byed do/ /byang phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog ⑨pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin 22—206

par byed do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par ①byed do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes ②rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par ①byed do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 22—207

pa 'di 'dri zhing klog ①pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang /ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par labyed do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing / klog pa dang /lung 'bog tsho )pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bud myed la la zhig la bu lnga'am/ bcu'am/nyi shu'am/ sum cu'am/ bzhi bcu'am/ lnga bcu'am/ brgya'am/ stong zhig yod na/ de dag ni ④ma de ci nas kyang myi na bar bya ba'i phyir brtson par byed cing / bdag cag gi ma 'di ji ltar na nad myed par 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ma 'di la pyogeji ltar na bar chad du myi 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ma 'di ji ltar na ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ma 'di ring du 'tsho bar bya na ji ltar bya / bdag cag gi ma 'di lus la myi bde ba'i nyams myed par bya na ༅ji ltar byaX/'di ni bdag cag skyed skyed pa ste/ srog gi sbyin bdag go zhes de dag ma de la rim gro legs par bya bas (8)rim gro byed do/ /de dag ni 'di'i srog gi bar chad du gyur du 'ong ngo / /lus nyams 7chung bar gyur du 'ong ngo / /lus la sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrul gyis gtse ba'i ⑩spyi bde bas bab tu 'ong ngo / /tsha ba dang / grang ba dang / bkres pa dang / skom pas myi bde bar 'gyur ⑩du 'ong ngo zhes phu phonyedud legs par bya bas phu dud phonyebyed do/ /de ltar bu de dag ma de la 'di ni bdag cag skyed skyed pa'o/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'di ston 22—208

pa'o zhes bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rgyun tu rim gro byed cing / sti ①stang dang / bkur ste cher byed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad ②par gzigs shing dgongs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bdag cag gi sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad skyed skyed pa'o/ /'jig rten 'di ston ston pa'o zhes rgyun tu gzigs shing ①dgongs so/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang ga'i duklung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang /chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /22—209
