gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chos thams cad stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi ①dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing /myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yang dag par spong ba rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing /myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi 22—351

mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dbang po rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stobs rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshad myed pa rnams bsam gyis byuskyi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa brgyad bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing /myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar 22—352

pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mngon par shes pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ting nge 'dzin rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzungs kyi sgo rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi 'jigs pa bzhi ①bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du byams pa chen po bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du snying rje chen po bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma ②mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bsam gyis myi 22—353

khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dgra bcom pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang byang chub bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen ②pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gnyis ④pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du shes la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du byed la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang 22—354

myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa stiskyi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor lce la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sgra la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dri la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ro la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor reg la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa 22—355

dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna'i rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce'i rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus kyi rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so//22—356

rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi hu)'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sa'i khams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chu'i khams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mye'i khams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rlung gi khams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor nam mkha'i khams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa'i khams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ma rig pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du byed la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang 22—357

mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mying dang gzugs la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor skye mched drug la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor reg pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam ①pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sred pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor len pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor srid pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor skye ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rga shi la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor bsam gtan 22—358

gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang ①mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor phyi stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor phyi nang stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chen po stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'dus byas stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la yang ②bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa myi 22—359

dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rang bzhin stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so / /rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yang dag par spong ba rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dbang po rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor stobs rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la yang 22—360

bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor bsam gtan rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshad myed pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang ①/ tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor de 22—361

bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myi 'jigs pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la yang bsam pa dang cadapag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor byams pa chen po la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor snying rje chen po la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so / /rab 'byor dgra bcom pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs ①so/ /rab 'byor rang byang chub la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /22—362

tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshor ba hunyel ②bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du 'du shes la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'du byed la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mig la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du rna ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sna la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sgra la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dri la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi 22—363

dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ro la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du reg la pha bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chos la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mig gi rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du sna'i rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce'i rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi rnam par shes pa ①la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du yid kyi rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa ②lags/ ci'i slad du myig gi 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags / ci'i slad du sna'i 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang ①dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce'i 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi 22—364

mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags / ci'i slad du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sa'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang ①kyi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chu'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags②/ ci'i slad du mye'i khams la/ bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rlung gi khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi 22—365

mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du nam mkha'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du rnam par ①shes pa'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ma rig pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'du byed la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad ②dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mying dang gzugs la bsam ①pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du skye mched drug la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sred pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du len pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du srid pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du skye ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rga shi la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang 22—366

mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshul khrims kyi she)pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags / ci'i slad du nang stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyi stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyi nang stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang ②dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chen po stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du don dam pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/22—367

ci'i slad du 'dus byas stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang bzhin stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chos thams cad stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dran pa 22—368

nye bar gzhag pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yang dag par spong ba rnams la bsam pa dang ①dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du dbang po rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stobs rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags / ci'i slad du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags / ci'i slad du tshad myed pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 22—369

'jug pa dgu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mngon par shes pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ting nge 'dzin rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du gzungs kyi sgo rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi 'jigs pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du byams pa chen po la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du snying rje chen po la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags / ci'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ci'i slad du hu)rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lan cig 22—370

phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dgra bcom pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang byang chub la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa zhu)shes pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid/bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu skyed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du shes kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir 'du shes la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du byed kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir 'du byed 22—371

la bsam pa dang ①dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir myig la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du skyed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rna ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sna la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir lce la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lus la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir yid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /22—372

rab 'byor gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sgra'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sgra la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dri'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/de'i phyir dri la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ro'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir ro la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor reg gi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang ①mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir reg la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir chos la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir myig gi rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi 22—373

mnyam hu)pa dang mnyam pa ②ste/ de'i phyir rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sna'i rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lce'i rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir lus kyi rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir yid kyi rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang ③dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir myig gi 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa 22—374

dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir sna'i 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lce'i 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te 22—375

reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rtse'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang ①dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa ②dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sa'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sa'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chu'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir chu'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mye'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu 22—376

myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir mye'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa ①dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rlung gi khams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rlung gi khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor nam mkha'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir nam mkha'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rnam par shes pa'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ma rig pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir ma rig pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du byed kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir 'du byed la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mying dang gzugs kyi 22—377

ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir mying dang gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor skye mched drug gi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir skye mched drug la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor reg pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sred pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sred pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor len pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir len pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor srid pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir srid pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor skye ba'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi 22—378

mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir skye ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rga shi'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rga shi la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/de'i phyir bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang 22—379

mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir nang stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor phyi stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir phyi stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi ①mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir phyi nang stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chen po stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir chen po stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa 22—380

dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir don dam pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir 'dus byas stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so / /rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir thog ma dang tha ma ①med pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rang bzhin stong pa 22—381

nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir chos thams cad (1)stong pa nyid ②la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /22—382

tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir yang dag par spong ba rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dbang po rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu shimyed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir dbang po rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so(ge/ /rab 'byor stobs rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir stobs rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ngo bo nyid 22—383

bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du skyed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor bsam ①gtan rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste / de'i phyir bsam gtan rnams la bsam pa dang / dpag pa dang tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshad myed pa rnams ②kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir tshad myed pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag ②pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab 22—384

dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir mngon par shes pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir ting nge 'dzin rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir gzungs kyi sgo rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyes myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 22—385

'byor myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa ①dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir myi 'jigs pa rnams ②la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs sol/ /rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir so so yang dag par rig pa rnams (gyil bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir byams pa chen po la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor snying rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir snying rje chen po la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la bsam pa dang dpag ④pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang ⑤mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal 22—386

du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor dgra bcom pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir dgra bcom pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rang byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rang byang chub la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir lam gyi rnam pa ②shis pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu skyed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gsum (kyepa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu 22—387

myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la gzugs dmyigs su yod dam/ tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ 'du shes gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la 'du shes dmyigs su yod dam/ 'du byed gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la 'du byed dmyigs su yod dam/ rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ myig gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la myig dmyigs su yod dam/ rna ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rna ba dmyigs su yod dam/ sna gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sna dmyigs su yod dam/ lce gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lce dmyigs su yod dam/ lus gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lus dmyigs su yod dam / yid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la yid dmigs su yod dam/ gzugs gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la gzugs dmyigs su yod dam/ sgra gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sgra dmyigs su yod dam/22—388

dri gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la dri dmyigs su yod dam/ ro gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la ro dmyigs su yod dam / reg gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la reg dmyigs su yod dam/ chos gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la chos dmyigs su yod dam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la myig gi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ sna'i rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sna'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ lce'i rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lce'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu skyed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lus kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la yid kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su yod dam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la myig gi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/ rna 22—389

ba'i 'dus te reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/sna'i 'dus te reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sna'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/lce'i 'dus te reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lce'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab 22—390

dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmigs su yod dam/ sa'i khams gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sa'i khams dmyigs su yod dam/ chu'i khams gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la chu'i khams dmyigs su yod dam/mye'i khams gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la mye'i khams dmyigs su yod dam/ rlung gi khams gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rlung gi khams dmyigs su yod dam/ nam mkha'i khams gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la nam mkha'i khams dmyigs su yod dam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rnam par shes pa'i khams dmyigs su yod dam/ ma rig pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la ma rig pa dmyigs su yod dam/ 'du byed gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang ①mnyam pa de la 'du byed dmyigs su yod dam/ rnam par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rnam par shes pa dmyigs 22—391

su yod dam/ mying dang gzugs gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la mying dang gzugs dmyigs su yod dam/ skye mched drug gang ①bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la skye mched drug dmyigs su yod dam/reg pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la reg pa dmyigs su yod dam/ tshor ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la tshor ba dmyigs su yod dam/ sred pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sred pa dmyigs su yod dam/len pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa ②dang mnyam pa de la len pa dmyigs su yod dam/ srid pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la srid pa dmyigs su yod dam/ skye ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la skye ba dmyigs su yod dam/ rga shi gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rga shi dmyigs su yod dam/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su yod dam/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su yod dam/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed 22—392

pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su yod dam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su yod dam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su yod dam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su yod dam / nang stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/phyi stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la phyi stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la phyi nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ chen po stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam 22—393

pa dang mnyam pa de la 'dus byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu med gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu skyed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rang bzhin stong pa nyid dmigs su yod dam/chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed 1)gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ ngo bo 22—394

nyid stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa ①dang mnyam pa de la ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang bsam gyis ②phyi khyab dpag tu myed (57gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ dran pa nye rngubar gzhag pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ yang dag par spong ba gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la yang dag par spong ba rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la rdzu 'phrul gyi ⑤kang pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam / dbang po gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la dbang po rnams dmyigs su yod dam/stobs gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la stobs rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ byang chub kyi yan lag gang bsam gyis myi khyab ⑥dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dmyigs su yod dam/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang ⑦mnyam pa de dag la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 6)dmyigs su yod dam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de 22—395

dag la 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ bsam gtan gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la bsam gtan rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ tshad myed pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la tshad myed pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ rnam par thar pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la rnam par thar pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ rnam par thar ①pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dmyigs su yod dam/ mngon par shes pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la mngon par shes pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ ting nge 'dzin gang bsam khugyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la ting nge 'dzin rnams dmyigs su yod dam/gzungs ②kyi sgo gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi 22—396

mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la gzungs kyi sgo rnams dmyigs su yod dam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa lhadang mnyam pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ myi 'jigs pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la myi 'jigs pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ so so yang dag par rig pa gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dmyigs su yod dam/ byams pa chen po gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de rgyal byams pa chen po dmyigs su yod dam/ snying rje chen po gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de snyel snying rje chen po dmyigs su yod dam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de dag la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dmigs su yod dam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de ngul rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dmyigs su yod dam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de ⑤la lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dmigs su yod dam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dmyigs su yod dam/22—397

dgra bcom pa nyid tshoshetshogang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la dgra bcom pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ rang byang chub gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rang byang chub dmyigs su yod dam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la lam gyi tsharnam pa shes pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa de la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dmyigs su yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas na rnam grangs 'dis chos thams cad bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'di dag ni bsam pa dang bral ba'i phyir bsam gyis myi khyab pa'o / /dpag pa dang bral ba'i ri dziphyir dpag tu myed pa'o/ /tshad dang bral ba'i phyir gzhal du myed pa'o/ /mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa dang bral ba'i phyir myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na chos thams cad bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o / /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'di dag ni bsam pa las yongs su 'das pas na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ongu/ /dpag pa las yongs su 'das pas na dpag tu myed pa'o/ /tshad las yongs su 'das pas na gzhal du myed pa'o/ /dumanyam pa dang myi mnyam pa las yongs su 22—398

'das pas na/ ①bya mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya ba 'di ni bsam ②du myed pa'i tshig bla dgas so/ /rab 'byor dpag tu myed ces bya ba 'di ni dpag tu myi rung ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /rab 'byor gzhal du myed ces ①bya ba 'di ni tshad myed pa'i tshig bla dgas so/ /rab 'byor myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mnyam pas mnyam pa myed pa'i tshig bla dgas tedu/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'di dag ni bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya ba ni nam mkha' bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /dpag tu myed ces bya ba ni nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhal du myed ces bya ba ni nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir ro/ /myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i phyir te⑤/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos de dag ni bsam gyis myi khyab pa dudapag tu myed pa ⑦gzhal du myed pa/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de dag ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bsam pa'am dpag par myi nus te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas rnams ni gzhal du myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni gzhal du myed do/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa dang ⑧dpag tu myed pa dang ⑨gzhal du myed pa dang / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i le'u 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ dge slong lnga brgya nye bar len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /dge slong ma brgya phrag nyi shus tshunye bar len pa myed par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /dge bsnyen pha 0stong 22—399
