stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ①ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba med pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro mi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba skyed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid 22—640

ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba med pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba med pa ste༅/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /dbang po rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /stobs rnams kyi stong 22—641

pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to / / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste / de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /①'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang/ mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi ②'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 22—642

'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba skyed pa ste/de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /byams pa chen po'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /snying rje chen po'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos riston to/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rang byang chub kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya 22—643

bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa ①nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid ni 'gro ba myed pa ste/ de ni myi 'gro myi 'ong ngo zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can rnams kyi lam du gyur pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul ②de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mtshan ma myed pa'i ngang tshul ①can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mtshan ma myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni/ smon pa myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe lan/ smon pa skyed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can tedu/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni myi skye myi 'gag pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ myi skye myi 'gag pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/22—644

de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rmi lam gyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyi lam la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgyu ma la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sgra brnyan gyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgra brnyan la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni myig yor gyi ngang tshul can te ①de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ myig yor la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni gzugs brnyan gyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs brnyan la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba mi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sbyig rgyu'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snyig rgyu la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni chu zla'i ngang tshul can te②/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chu zla la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sprul pa'i ngang tshul can te③/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sprul pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i ngang tshul can te/22—645

de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dbyung ba dang myi dbyung ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dbyung ba dang myi dbyung ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dbri ba dang bsnan pa myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dbri ba dang bsnan pa myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni 'ong ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'ong ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni blang ba dang dor ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blang ba dang dor ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyer gnyis ①pa/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni phrad pa myed pa dang bral ②ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/phrad pa myed pa dang bral ①ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni 'dre ba myed pa dang / myi 'dre ba myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'dre ba skyed pa dang rjo/ myi 'dre ba myed pa la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so//rab 'byor chos thams cad ni bdag gi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de 22—646

las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor bdag nyid kyang shin tu myed na①/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sems can gyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sems can nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni srog gi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor srog nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni 'gro ba'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las ②phyi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'gro ba nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni/gso ba'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor gso ba nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni skyes bu'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor skyes bu nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni gang zag gi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor gang zag nyid kyang shin tu myed na/de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni shed can gyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor shed can nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni shed bdag gi ngang tshul can te/22—647

de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor shed ①bdag nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni byed pa po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byed pa po ②nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni byed du 'jug pa ①po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byed du 'jug pa po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni slong ba po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor slong ba po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni yongs su slong ba po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor yongs su slong ba po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni tshor ba po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor tshor ba po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni tshor bar dubyed pa po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor tshor bar ⑤byed pa po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni shes pa po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor shes pa po nyid kyang shin tu 22—648

skyed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mthong ba po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mthong ba po nyid kyang shin tu skyed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rtag pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rtag pa nyid kyang shin tu skyed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni bde ba'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor bde ba nyid kyang shin tu skyed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni bdag gi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor bdag nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sdug pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las mi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sdug pa nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni myi rtag pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor myi rtag pa nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sdug bsngal gyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor/ sdug bsngal nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am/ 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni/ bdag myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 22—649

'byor bdag myed pa nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod / rab 'byor chos thams cad ni myi sdug pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor myi sdug pa nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni 'dod chags kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'dod chags kyi dngos po ①nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni zhe sdang gi zhungang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor zhe snang gi dngos po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni gti mug gi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor gti mug gi dngos po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor lta ba'i rnam pa'i dngos po nyid kyang shin tu myed na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni de bzhin nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor de bzhin nyid la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos kyi dbyings la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni yang dag pa'i 22—650

de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ①ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni chen po stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chen po stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams 22—660

cad ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las ①phyi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/22—661

rab 'byor dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las mi 'da'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab ①'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor ②chos thams cad ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni yang dag par spong ba'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dbang po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor dbang po rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni stobs kyi ngang tshul can te/ de 22—662

'byor chos thams cad ni rnam par thar pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rarbe 'byor chos thams cad ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mngon par shes pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rkyangang tshul can te/de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni gzungs kyi sgo'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi ngang tshul can te/ de 22—664

dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ba cu yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni myi 'jigs pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor myi 'jigs pa bzhi yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni so so yang dag par rig pa'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni byams pa chen po'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor byams pa chen po yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni snying rje chen po'i ngang tshul can te/de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor snying rje chen po yang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i ngang tshul can te/de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang shin tu myi dmyigs na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang shin tu myi dmyigs ①na / de la du'agro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad 22—665

ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang shin tu myi dmyigs ①na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang shin tu myi dmyigs ②na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni dgra bcom pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te/de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dgra bcom pa nyid kyang shin tu myi dmyigs ②na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang byang chub kyi ngang tshul can te/ de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rang byang chub kyang shin tu myi dmyigs ④na/ de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba lta ga la yod/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ngang tshul can te/de dag ni ngang tshul de las myi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ⑤de la 'gro ba'am 'ong ba myi dmyigs soyi / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar zab pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la su zhig mos par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 0bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs ⑧pa'i byang chub tu sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi drung du spyad par gyur pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su sbyin pa/ sangs rgyas mang po ⑨bsnyen bkur ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba de dag ⑩22—666

'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang shin tu myed la/byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ bsam gtan dang 'brel pa ma yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor bsam gtan rnams kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni bsam gtan dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ tshad skyed pa dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor tshad myed pa rnams kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni tshad myed pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o//rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni①/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang shin tu skyed la/byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni rnam par thar pa brgyad dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i ②go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni rnam par thar pa brgyad dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor 22—687

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang shin tu myed la/byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ①dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang shin tu myed la / byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ mngon par shes pa dang 'brel pa ma yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams kyang shin tu myed la/byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni mngon par shes pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang shin tu med la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni gzungs kyi sgo dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/22—688

rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni gzungs kyi sgo ①deng 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang shin tu myed la/byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ myi 'jigs pa ②dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni myi 'jigs pa dudang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas / de'i phyir go cha de ni so so yang dag par rig pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni byams pa chen po dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byams pa chen po yang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni byams pa chen po dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o//rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni snying rje chen po dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor snying rje chen po 22—689

yang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni snying rje chen po dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang skyed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ①yang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pasal/ de'i phyir go cha de ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid dang 'brel pa ma yin te/22—690

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dgra bcom pa nyid kyang shin tu myed la byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni dgra bcom pa nyid dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ rang byang chub dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rang byang chub kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni rang byang chub dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor lam gyi rnam pa ②shis pa nyid kyang shin tu skyed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/ de'i phyir go cha de ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang 'brel pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang shin tu myed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i go cha yang myed pas/de'i phyir go cha de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang 'brel pa ma yin zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa gang dag gis/ sems can thams cad bdag ③gis yongs su mya ngan las bzla dubar bya'o zhes/ go cha ⑤bgos pa de dag gi go cha ni chos thams cad dang 'brel pa ma yin no/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla dubar bya'o zhes/ go cha 'tshal ba des nyan 22—691

thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnas gnyis su dogs par myi bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ①bar bya'o zhes go cha 'tshal ba'o/ /②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ①nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar nyung ba'i gnas dang skabs ma mchis te/ de ni gnas ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sa mtshams dubacad de/ sems can gyi don du go cha 'tshal ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor khyod kyis don gyi dbang gang zhig mthong na/ de skad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar go cha bgos shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa des/ nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnas gnyis su dogs par myi bya'o zhes smras/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos dudes sems can nyi tse ༷nyung zad cig ⑦gi slad du go cha 'tshal ba ma lags/ ye shes nyung zad nyi tse nizhig gi slad du go cha 'tshal ba ma lags te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni/⑨sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ⑩ba'i slad du go cha 'tshal to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi slad du go cha 'tshal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i 4)don du go cha bgos pa ma yin/ ye shes nyung 8zad nyi tse'i 8don du go cha bgos pa ma yin gyi/22—692

rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems ①dpa' chen pos ni sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ②ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi don du go cha bgos so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni shin tu zab pa ste/ de ni sus kyang bsgom par myi bgyi/ ci yang bsgom par myi bgyi/ gang du yang bsgom par mi bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la gang bsgom pa'am/ gang bsgom par bgyi ba'am/ gang gis bsgom par bgyi ba'i chos gang yang yongs su grub pa dmyigs su ma mchis te②/ bcom ldan 'das rjoshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa de ni/ nam mkha' bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa de ni/chos thams cad bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa de ni/ ma mchis pa bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ⑤phyin pa bsgom pa de ni/ yongs su 'dzin pa ma mchis pa bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa de ni/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar dushes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa de ⑦gang bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa yin/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ gzugs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/22—693

'du shes bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'du byed bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ①phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ②ni/myig bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rna ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o//bcom ldan 'das ③'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/sna bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lce bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/lus bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ yid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o//bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/gzugs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sgra bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ dri bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ ro bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ reg bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta 22—694

ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ chos bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/rna ba'i rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/myig gi 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lus kyi 'dus te ①reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /22—695

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ①bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid ②bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/rang byang chub bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lam gyi rnam pa ③shes pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgosapa 'di ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ gzugs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'du shes bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'du byed bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha 22—703

pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/sna'i rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni / yid kyi rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/lce'i 'dus te rig pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o//rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rna 22—705

ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sa'i khams bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ chu'i khams bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o//rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ mye'i khams bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rlung gi khams bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ①phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ nam mkha'i khams bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ ma rig pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom 22—706

pa 'di ni/ 'du byed bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rnam par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di rnye ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ ming dang gzugs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ skye mched drug bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ reg pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ tshor ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sred pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ len pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ srid pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ skye ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rga shi bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ bdag bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sems can bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ srog bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/22—707

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'gro ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ gso ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ skyes bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ gang zag bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ shed can bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ shed bdag bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ byed pa po bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ tshor ba po bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ shes pa po bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ mthong ba po bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①bsgom pa 'di ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 22—708

pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ nang stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ phyi stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ chen po stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o//rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/don dam pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ thog 22—709

ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ②phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o//rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ yang dag par spong ba bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi ③pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/22—710

dbang po bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ stobs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/byang chub kyi yan lag bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ①pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ bsam gtan bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ tshad myed pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rnam par thar pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ mngon par shes pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di 22—711

ni / ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ gzungs kyi sgo bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ myi 'jigs pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ byams pa chen po bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ snying rje chen po bsgom pa rnam par bsgo ma pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rang byang chub bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /22—712

rab 'byor 'di lta ste/① shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ lam gyi rnam pa ②shis pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la ③byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di dul mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ rab 'byor ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la 0phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑦yongs su brtag ⑧par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 0gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ()yongs su brtag thonyepar bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tsoyongs su brtag tu)par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag ④par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag 8par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems 22—713

dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes nang stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag ①par bya'o / /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyi stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes phyi stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par mebya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyi nang stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes phyi nang stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chen po stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes chen po stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don dam pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes don dam pa stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dus byas stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa ②skyed dam zhes 'dus byas stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag 22—714

par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o / /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes rang bzhin stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub 22—715

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems ①dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la mngon par ②chags pa myed dam zhes / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang dag par spong ba rnams la/ mngon par chags pa med dam zhes yang dag par spong ba rnams la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la/ mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 22—716

dbang po rnams la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes dbang po rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po stobs rnams la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes stobs rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ①chen po 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan rnams la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ bsam gtan rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'ol/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la mngon par chags pa skyed dam zhes tshad myed pa rnams la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par — 22—717

gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi 'jigs pa rnams la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes myi 'jigs pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa chen po la mngon par chags pa med dam zhes byams pa chen po la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes snying rje chen po la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad shes pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ thams cad shes pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam/ zhes lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la byang 22—719

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par chags pa myed dam zhes/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yongs su brtag par bya'o// //①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu bzhi ②pa/phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ pha rol gyis smras pa dang / pha rol gyis bstan pa la snying por myi lta'am/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ pha rol gyi sridad pas myi 'gro'am/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems bskyed pas 'phrogs pa ma yin nam/ zhe sdang dang bcas pa'i sems bskyed pas 'phrogs pa ma yin nam/gti mug dang bcas pa'i sems bskyed pas 'phrogs pa ma yin nam/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur tam/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur tam/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur tam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur tam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur tam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur tam zhes yongs su brtag par bya ste/ gal te phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems 22—720

dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'chad pa'i tshe/ myi 'jigs myi sngang hu)skrag par myi 'gyur la/ zhum pa dang yongs su zhum par mi 'gyur zhing / de'i yid phyir nur bar myi 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos par dga' la/ thos nas kyang 'dzin cing 'chang la/ klog cing kun chub par byed de/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed laXci/de bzhin nyid du nan tan du byed na/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des ni sngon gyi mthar yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yongs su dris shing yongs su brtag pa snyebyas pa dang / bzung zhing cho bcangs te/ kun chub par byas pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byas par rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'chad pa'i tshe/ myi 'jigs mi sngang geskrag par myi 'gyur la/ zhum par myi 'gyur/yongs su zhum par myi 'gyur zhing / de'i yid phyir myi ldog la/ thos nas kyang gong du yo'adzin cing 'chang la/ klog cing kun chub par byed pa deme/tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu 2phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ myi 'jigs myi sngang shemospag par myi 'gyur zhing /zhum par myi 'gyur / yongs su zhum par myi 'gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ji ltar brtag 0 par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/ rnam pa thams 22—721

cad mkhyen pa nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di brtag ①par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ⑤rtog pa lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor stong pa nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor mtshan ma myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor smon pa myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor nam mkha' la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor skye ba myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor 'gag pa myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor rnam par byang ba myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor de 22—722

bzhin nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor yang dag pa'i mtha' la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/rab 'byor bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gzhol ba'i bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor spyi lam la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor gzugs brnyan la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor sgra brnyan la gzhol ba'i bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor snyig rgyu la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin/ rab 'byor sgyu ma la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems 22—723

dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin / rab 'byor sprul pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog pa yin no//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar stong pa nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ mtshan ma myed pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ smon pa med pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur②/ nam mkha' la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ skye ba ma mchis pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ kun nas nyon mongs pa zhudang / rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ de bzhin nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes 22—724

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ mngon par 'du bgyi ba ma mchis pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/spyi lam la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ gzugs brnyan la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub ①sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ sgra brnyan la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ snyig rgyu la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ sgyu ma la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur/ sprul pa la gzhol ba'i bsam pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ②chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rtog par 'gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 22—725

chen po gzugs la rtog pa lags sam/ tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ 'du shes la rtog pa lags sam/ 'du byed la rtog pa lags sam/ rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ myig la rtog pa lags sam/ rna ba la rtog pa lags sam/sna la rtog pa lags sam/ lce la rtog pa lags sam/ lus la rtog pa lags sam/yid la rtog pa lags sam/ gzugs la rtog pa lags sam/ sgra la rtog pa lags sam / dri la rtog pa lags sam/ ro la rtog pa lags sam/ reg la rtog pa lags sam/ chos la rtog pa lags sam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ sna'i rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ lce'i rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/lus kyi rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ sa'i khams la rtog pa lags sam/ chu'i khams la rtog pa lags sam/ mye'i khams la rtog pa lags sam/ rlung gi khams la rtog pa lags sam/ nam mkha'i khams la rtog pa 22—726

lags sam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams la rtog pa lags sam/ ma rig pa la rtog pa lags sam/ 'du byed la rtog pa lags sam/ rnam par shes pa la rtog pa lags sam/ mying dang gzugs la rtog pa lags sam/ skye mched drug la rtog pa lags sam/ reg pa la rtog pa lags sam/ tshor ba la rtog pa lags sam/ sred pa la rtog pa lags sam/ len pa la rtog pa lags sam/ srid pa la rtog pa lags sam/ skye ba la rtog pa lags sam/ rga shi la rtog pa lags sam/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog pa lags sam/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog pa lags sam/ bzod pa'i pha rol ①tu phyin pa la rtog pa lags sam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog pa lags sam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog pa lags sam/ shes rab kyi pha ②rol tu phyin pa la rtog pa lags sam / nang stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ phyi stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam / phyi nang stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ chen po stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ thog ma dang tha ma ②skyed pa stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la ④rtog pa lags sam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rtog pa lags sam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong 22—727
